facts.text_en: Production began in 1990; through 2014 the mine had produced 22 million tonnes of copper, 21% of all copper mined in Chile.
facts.text_es: La produccion comenzo en 1990; hasta 2014 la mina habia producido 22 millones de toneladas de cobre, el 21% de todo el cobre extraido en Chile.

facts.text_en: The main pit is 645 m deep, the height of two Eiffel Towers stacked.
facts.text_es: El rajo principal tiene 645 m de profundidad, la altura de dos torres Eiffel apiladas.

facts.text_en: In 2025 Escondida produced 1,345,100 tonnes of fine copper, its highest level since 2007.
facts.text_es: En 2025 Escondida produjo 1.345.100 toneladas de cobre fino, su nivel mas alto desde 2007.
